title: should enter print mode via the toolbar button and render the print layout
verifies: toggling the print button renders the print layout (URL print=true, print chrome, @page style, grid height set, panels force-mounted)

title: should exit print mode and clear the print layout
verifies: toggling print off removes the @page style, restores the action chrome, and clears the injected grid height

title: should enter print mode via the ?print=true URL and persist across reload
verifies: loading the dashboard with ?print=true re-enters print mode on mount and keeps it after a reload

title: should render a single-table-panel dashboard full-width in print mode
verifies: a dashboard with exactly one table panel swaps the grid for a full-width table in print mode

title: should show the print-capture readiness flag once panels finish loading
verifies: the hidden capture-readiness span appears once all panels and variables finish loading

title: should inject no print page style for an empty dashboard in print mode
verifies: an empty dashboard in print mode injects no @page style, renders the empty state, and hides the add-panel CTA
